def _lj_energy(pos):
    """Compute total Lennard-Jones energy for N atoms."""
    n = len(pos)
    rij = np.zeros((n, n, 3))
    for i in range(n):
        rij[i, i+1:] = pos[i] - pos[i+1:]
        rij[i+1:, i] = -rij[i, i+1:]
